title: Azure Senior Data Lead
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

We are seeking a skilled Databricks Engineer to design, develop, and optimize data solutions on the Microsoft Azure platform. This role is critical in enabling data\-driven decision\-making by building scalable data pipelines, integrating diverse data sources, and delivering high\-quality analytics solutions aligned with business objectives.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Design and develop scalable data solutions using Azure Databricks and the Azure ecosystem
  
Build and manage Azure Data Factory (ADF) pipelines for efficient data ingestion and transformation
  
Integrate structured and unstructured data from multiple sources into Azure Data Lake / Analytics platforms
  
Develop ETL processes to support analytics and reporting requirements
  
Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality data solutions
  
Translate business requirements into technical designs and implement scalable architecture
  
Ensure performance optimization, data quality, and reliability across data pipelines
  
Support deployment and version control using Azure DevOps
  
Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Skills
  
  

Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure Stack (T\-SQL, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS)
  
  

**Hands\-on experience with:**  

Azure Data Factory (ADF)
  
Azure Databricks
  
Azure Synapse Analytics
  
Azure DevOps
  
Azure Storage / Data Lake
  
Solid understanding of ETL processes and data integration
  
Proficiency in SQL and relational databases
  
Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
  
  

Preferred Skills (Good to Have)
  
  

Experience with Python scripting and Spark APIs
  
Exposure to client\-facing roles and stakeholder interactions
  
Familiarity with Agile / Scrum methodologies
  
  

Educational Qualification
  
  

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science / Information Technology / related field
  
  

Skill Evaluation Matrix (Snapshot)
  
  

Azure Stack, ADF, Databricks, Synapse, ETL, SQL – Core strengths required
  
DevOps, Storage/Data Lake – Supporting capabilities
  
Python/Spark, Client Engagement, Agile – Added advantage
  
Other Requirements
  
1\.Relevant certifications in Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, SQL, Oracle, or Python would be a plus.

Description:
**Area(s) of responsibility**
-----------------------------

**Azure Synapse \& Data Engineering**


* Design, develop, and optimize solutions using **Azure Synapse Analytics**.
* Build and maintain data integration solutions using **Azure Data Factory (ADF)** and **Synapse Pipelines**.
* Design and implement scalable **Data Lake architectures (ADLS Gen2\)**.
* Develop high\-performance **ETL/ELT frameworks** for enterprise data platforms.
* Monitor and troubleshoot large\-scale data ingestion, transformation, and processing workloads.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and implement optimization strategies across data movement and transformation processes.
* Ensure data quality, availability, and reliability across analytics ecosystems. These responsibilities align with internally referenced practices around data warehousing, ETL optimization, data lakes, and Synapse performance tuning. \[25543668\-c...3291332387 \| Word]


**SQL \& Data Warehouse Performance**


* Perform advanced SQL query analysis and optimization.
* Analyze and optimize execution plans for complex analytical workloads.
* Configure and tune **Synapse Dedicated SQL Pools**.
* Design and implement efficient partitioning strategies for large datasets.
* Optimize indexing, statistics, and workload distribution.
* Perform capacity planning and performance benchmarking.
* Support data warehouse modernization and optimization initiatives.


**Required Technical Skills**


**Azure Technologies**


* Azure Synapse Analytics
* Azure Data Factory (ADF)
* Synapse Pipelines
* Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2\)
* Azure SQL Database
* Azure Monitoring and Log Analytics


**Data Engineering**


* ETL/ELT Design and Development
* Data Lake Architecture
* Data Integration and Orchestration
* Batch and Incremental Data Processing
* Performance Tuning and Optimization


**SQL \& Data Warehousing**


* Advanced T\-SQL
* Query Performance Tuning
* Execution Plan Analysis
* Data Modeling (Star Schema / Snowflake Schema)
* Partitioning and Indexing Strategies
* Statistics Management
* Synapse SQL Pools
* Data Warehouse Optimization


**Performance Engineering**


* Root Cause Analysis
* Workload Monitoring
* Troubleshooting Large\-Scale Data Processing
* Capacity Planning
* Performance Benchmarking

title: Lead MongoDB
description:
Qualification:
Description


We are seeking a highly experienced **MongoDB Architect** to lead a **large\-scale legacy data modernization initiative**, involving migration of **old mainframe\-based data systems** into a **modern MongoDB ecosystem**.


This role requires deep expertise in **data discovery, reverse engineering, canonical data modeling, and NoSQL schema design**, along with the ability to handle **highly complex, undocumented legacy systems**.

  

* Lead end\-to\-end **data architecture and migration strategy** from legacy mainframe systems to MongoDB
* Perform **data discovery and reverse engineering** of undocumented / poorly documented systems
* Analyze **mainframe data structures (VSAM, flat files, hierarchical data, etc.)**
* Define and design **canonical data models** for enterprise\-wide usage
* Design optimized **MongoDB document models (collections, embedding, referencing)**
* Establish **data transformation, cleansing, and mapping strategies**
* Build **data migration frameworks, pipelines** and **data Archival strategy**
* Ensure **data consistency, integrity, and reconciliation** during migration
* Implement **MongoDB best practices (indexing, sharding, replication, performance tuning)**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand **implicit data relationships and rules**
* Define **data governance, metadata, and lineage frameworks**
* Support validation, testing, and post\-migration stabilization
* Mentor teams on **NoSQL design principles and migration approaches**
* **API design** on the top of the **MongoDB Atlas**
* **Hands on** experiencein configuring **MongoDB Atlas cluster**

Role


**MongoDB \& NoSQL Expertise**


* Deep hands\-on experience with **MongoDB architecture**
* Migrating from RDBMS/SQL to MongoDB/NoSQL
* **Knowledge of MongoDB (Replica Sets, Sharding, Aggregation Framework)**
* Familiarity with **GCP cloud platforms**
* Strong expertise in:
	+ Document data modeling
	+ Schema design (embedding vs referencing)
	+ Indexing, aggregation framework
	+ Sharding and replication

**Data Modeling \& Architecture**


* Expertise in **canonical data modeling**
* Strong experience in:
	+ Data normalization vs denormalization
	+ Designing enterprise\-wide data models
	+ Mapping legacy data to modern schemas

**Data Migration \& Engineering**


* Experience in **large\-scale data migration programs** (Migrating from RDBMS/SQL to MongoDB/NoSQL)
* Knowledge of:
	+ ETL/ELT processes
	+ Data transformation and cleansing
	+ Data reconciliation techniques
* Experience with tools like **Spark / Python / data pipelines**

**Legacy System Understanding (Good to have)**


* Strong experience with **mainframe data systems**
* Knowledge of:
	+ VSAM files
	+ COBOL copybooks
	+ Flat files / hierarchical data structures
* Ability to work with **missing or undocumented codebases**

**Problem Solving \& Analysis**


* Strong analytical skills to **interpret legacy data without documentation**
* Ability to infer **business rules from data patterns**

**Performance \& Scalability**


* Experience in **performance tuning MongoDB workloads**
* Ability to design for **high\-volume, high\-velocity data systems**

* **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in **banking / insurance / government legacy systems**
* Exposure to **data governance frameworks**
* Familiarity with **cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)**
* Experience with **data cataloging and metadata tools**
* MongoDB certifications (Developer/DBA)

Maximum Years Of Experience


10


Minimum Years Of Experience


6


Skills Required:
MongoDB, Migration, AWS
